pages.title: Osorin's Unbound Calling
pages.text: $(bold)Purpose:$() Summon an unbound $(#AA00AA)Greater Spirit$()$(br2)$(bold)Osorin's Unbound Calling$() is based on $(#AA00AA)Abras' Open Conjure$(), but features none of the stabilizing paraphernalia. The pentacle offers no protection whatsoever to the summoner, but $()

pages.title: Osorin's Unbound Calling
pages.text: acts as an irresistible call to $(#AA00AA)Greater Spirits$().
